sp_session_expired.title: SP Services account {account_no} needs you to log in again
sp_session_expired.description:
The saved SP Services login for account {account_no} has ended. This happens when Home Assistant could not reach SP for more than 3 days, or when SP ends the session. Usage sensors stay unavailable until you log in again.

To fix it: run the login command again on your computer, then go to Settings > Devices & services > Singapore, find the SP Services account and choose Reconfigure. Paste the new session string. Usage history missed in the meantime is filled in automatically.
